label: Match Restore
description: Checkpoint / restore — saves and restores full match state (player positions, health, armor, items, score, clock) at referee-triggered checkpoints.

commands.name: restore
commands.usage: export | test [name] | quiet | loud | clear | time | map | player | item | apply | verify | show | players [slot:cid...]
commands.description: Checkpoint draft workflow — build, verify and apply a saved match-state snapshot.

commands.name: restorecheckpoint
commands.usage: export | test [name] | quiet | loud | clear | time | map | player | item | apply | verify | show | players [slot:cid...]

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns restore and the underlying clock/pause/item-restore engine on or off. Also gates the optional match_restore_lab plugin's debug commands (shared cvar).

cvars.label: Native Clock
cvars.description: Use the engine's own match clock instead of the plugin's tracked clock.

cvars.label: Unfreeze Delay (s)
cvars.description: Seconds to wait after applying a checkpoint before unfreezing play.
